one_liner: Smartsheet has a broad REST API with OAuth2 and API tokens plus an official MCP server, but API/token/OAuth app access requires a paid Business+ plan.
auth_notes: 3-legged OAuth 2.0 via Developer Tools registration (requires a paid-plan account); bearer access tokens generated in Personal Settings. Tokens are separate across Smartsheet.com, Regions Europe and Gov.
access_notes: The API is free to use but gated to Business, Enterprise, or Advanced Work Management plans. Free accounts cannot generate tokens or register OAuth apps. No free path or trial was evidenced.
blocker_notes: The builder needs a paid Business+ Smartsheet plan to generate API tokens and register OAuth apps. Otherwise the API is well documented.

evidence.quote: The API authenticates using access tokens (API keys). You can generate access tokens in the Smartsheet UI.
Developer Tools is a Smartsheet user interface for registering client applications that use OAuth to access Smartsheet user resources with the user's consent.
**Required plan:** Business, Enterprise, or Advanced Work Management
Free accounts cannot generate API access tokens or register OAuth apps.
Smartsheet has launched a generally available Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server.
